question: Which of the following is NOT a member of the Aves (birds) class?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pteropus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pteropus** is a genus of bats commonly known as flying foxes or fruit bats.
 
• They are the largest bats in the world, with some species having a wingspan of up to 1.5 meters.
 
• Pteropus species are primarily found in tropical and subtropical regions of Asia, Australia, East Africa, and some oceanic islands.
 
• These bats are not classified under the class Aves (birds) but belong to the order Chiroptera in the class Mammalia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aves (Birds)**

 
 
• Aves is a class of vertebrates that includes all birds.
 
• Birds are characterized by feathers, a beak without teeth, the laying of hard-shelled eggs, a high metabolic rate, a four-chambered heart, and a strong yet lightweight skeleton.
 
• Examples of birds include species like Psittacula (parrots), Neophron (vultures), and Struthio (ostriches).
 
 
 
• **Psittacula**
 
 
• Psittacula is a genus of parrots, commonly known as parakeets.
 
• They are characterized by their bright plumage and strong, curved beaks.
 
• These birds are primarily found in Asia and Africa.
 
 
 
• **Neophron**
 
 
• Neophron is a genus of vultures, commonly known as the Egyptian vulture.
 
• They are scavengers and are known for their distinctive bald heads and hooked beaks.
 
• These birds are found in Europe, Asia, and Africa.
 
 
 
• **Struthio**
 
 
• Struthio is a genus of birds that includes the ostrich.
 
• Ostriches are flightless birds known for their large size and long legs adapted for running.
 
• They are native to Africa and are the largest and heaviest living birds.
